checks: public tests and hidden behavior tests

cases.test_name: authorized positive and denied precedence with no collaborator calls
cases.mapped_public_behavior: Authorization precedes input and initialization, denied collaborators untouched, tenant-local IDs and caller tenant selector rejected

cases.test_name: calendar bounds, grammar, type and effective duplicate key policy
cases.mapped_public_behavior: Timestamp bounds/calendar/type/field/count/length boundaries, caller duplicate keys use effective last value

cases.test_name: later invalid event precedes earlier semantic conflict or underflow and no read
cases.mapped_public_behavior: Complete structural validation precedes replay/stock, invalid ingest performs no store work

cases.test_name: canonical fingerprint and every content field, duplicates, case sensitivity
cases.mapped_public_behavior: All event fields bind SDK canonical fingerprint, exact duplicates and reordered JSON replay, changed content conflicts, case-sensitive IDs/SKUs

cases.test_name: ordered transitions, zero deletion, chronological freedom, upper bound
cases.mapped_public_behavior: Sequential stock bounds, zero-key removal, chronology is unrestricted

cases.test_name: first semantic error, replay at capacity and stock before capacity
cases.mapped_public_behavior: Replay at ledger capacity, stock precedes capacity, first semantic error and atomic capacity boundary

cases.test_name: late failure leaves ledger, stock, bytes and counts unchanged without encoding
cases.mapped_public_behavior: Late failure exposes no staged data or signing/CAS, novel batch single CAS/revision, exact counts and all-replay no rewrite

cases.test_name: maximum revision staging precedence, replay succeeds without encode
cases.mapped_public_behavior: Semantic staging precedes maximum revision error, replay success at maximum without encode/CAS

cases.test_name: scheduled winner, unchanged loser, explicit refresh and retry
cases.mapped_public_behavior: Independent instances race with one winner, failed CAS preserves loser, no hidden read/retry, explicit restore then retry

cases.test_name: read/CAS exceptions preserve state and release busy
cases.mapped_public_behavior: Read/CAS failures preserve initialized state, release busy, failed refresh keeps old revision for CAS conflict

cases.test_name: same-instance overlapping restore/ingest returns immediately busy without work
cases.mapped_public_behavior: Busy precedes initialization/input while restore/ingest pending, same-instance calls perform no extra collaborator work

cases.test_name: deterministic sorted canonical roundtrip and trusted integrity use
cases.mapped_public_behavior: Sorted deterministic SDK canonical outer/payload, trusted signing/verification, empty revision-zero and replay-only states

cases.test_name: all invalid encode state domains reject
cases.mapped_public_behavior: Encode state domain bounds and grammar reject invalid states

cases.test_name: bad MAC, byte tamper, noncanonical outer and base64 reject
cases.mapped_public_behavior: MAC/tamper, canonical outer and padded base64, strict UTF8, tag grammar reject invalid checkpoints

cases.test_name: authenticated malformed states and noncanonical payloads reject
cases.mapped_public_behavior: Authenticated malformed domain/schema/type/tenant/revision and noncanonical/duplicate persisted payload reject

cases.test_name: each copy independently recoverable, no repair until novel ingest
cases.mapped_public_behavior: Independent copies recover only current revision, no restore/all-replay repair, novel ingest repairs both copies

cases.test_name: invalid record, contradictory valid copies, stale recovery and preservation
cases.mapped_public_behavior: Invalid revision/empty form/disagreement/stale/foreign copies corrupt, failed refresh preserves state, both revision-zero forms accepted

cases.test_name: defensive constructors, frozen captured views, checkpoint immutability
cases.mapped_public_behavior: Protected defensive value constructors, decoded maps and captured views immutable, replay ledger survives restart

cases.test_name: first failed restore stays uninitialized before caller input or crypto work
cases.mapped_public_behavior: Uninitialized ingest precedes parsing/crypto, failed first restores stay uninitialized, later valid restore succeeds
Freeze pre-operation values and observe current/busy view while CAS waits, then settle success, real revision mismatch or precommit store failure; failed attempt does not publish ledger
cases.test_name: C20 current and busy view preserve captured state while CAS pending

cases.mapped_public_behavior: Each canonical outer/base64 invalid UTF8 or JSON invokes verification exactly once before rejection; covers true/false MAC and false MAC over valid payload
cases.test_name: C21 verify boundary is called once before malformed payload rejection

cases.mapped_public_behavior: Valid multibyte duplicate-key JSON with valid effective content exceeds UTF8 byte limit while under character limit; invalidBatch and no store work
cases.test_name: C22 valid effective JSON exceeds UTF8 bytes but not character limit

verification_order_observation_limit: C21 distinguishes payload-first malformed rejection without verification. Parsing first but delaying every rejection until after verification has identical black-box observations with the current pure SDK parser and IntegrityService API.

assertion_precision.positive_requirements: Successful code and non-null mandatory state checked before dereference; valid codec operations must not throw; original cause/trace included in assertion diagnostics
assertion_precision.pending_operation_teardown: Each deterministic gate is released and its operation awaited; unexpected completion errors retained as contract assertions
